artists.curator_summary: Music-native nostalgia-wave fantasy built from luminous PS2/Dreamcast-era 3D worlds: aquamarine island sanctuaries, violet-haired navigators, floating gothic citadels, angelic save points, waterfalls, moons, starfall and ambient electronic memory.
artists.rights_release_gate: Reference/curation only until artist permission or license is recorded

worlds.world_thesis: A living indoor wetland laboratory where playful frog-folk, fruiting mushrooms and soft gelatinous architecture coexist with a dense professional interface.

glossary.meaning: A complete Feature Foundry theme package dedicated to a favorite artist’s coherent visual universe.
A major variant with distinct visual and interaction identity, such as Frawgy green daylight versus purple nocturne.
An authored sub-reality inside a world with its own environment, weather, routing and use mode.
A discovered playlist awaiting listening review. It is not approved merely because its title matches.
The source page, capture method, file identity, hash, rights note and derivative lineage for every reference or asset.
A rule preventing the artist theme from collapsing into a common broad aesthetic or recycled template.
A theme family where sacred ritual, ceremonial symbolism and futuristic machinery are fused into one coherent living UI world.
A theme family examining bodies, consciousness and living systems as mutable hybrids of biological, textile, virtual and intelligent processes.
A music-native world family drawing on late-1990s and 2000s console-era 3D fantasy, tropical sanctuary spaces, game-save symbolism and emotionally restorative ambient memory.
